results = []

 need(s['schema'].map { |c| [c['name'],c['type']] }==schema && s['keys']==[1,2,3,4,5] && s['mark_row_counts']==[2,2,1], 'nominal schema/grid')

 need(Digest::SHA256.file(s['runtime']['path']).hexdigest==runtime_sha && s['runtime']['sha256']==runtime_sha,'runtime pin')
 need(Digest::SHA256.file(s['helper']['path']).hexdigest==s['helper']['sha256'],'helper binary pin')
 s['source_closures'].values.flatten.each { |e| need(Digest::SHA256.file(e['path']).hexdigest==e['sha256'],"source closure #{e['path']}") }
 s['runtime']['source_pins'].each do |tree|

 end
 current=s['runtime']['source_pins'].find { |e| e['tree']=='clickhouse-2026-10-10-depth1' }
 need(current && current['revision']=='fe0f91b6c3de9e1efa33a1bce4ca9bcbfb4c509d' && current['commit_time_utc']=='2026-10-10T09:01:51Z' && current['files'].size==15,'current source identity')
 s['invocations'].each do |record|
   r=JSON.parse(File.binread(File.join(root,'invocations',record['label']+'.json')))
   need(r==record,'raw record/summary agreement')
   need(r['exit']==0 && r['signal'].nil? && !r['timed_out'] && r['process_classification']=='success','process exit')
   %w[spawn_error stdin_write_error stdout_read_error stderr_read_error].each { |key| need(r[key].nil?,key) }
   %w[argv stdin stdout stderr].each do |key|
     path=File.join(root,'invocations',r[key+'_file'])
     need(File.file?(path) && !File.symlink?(path),'raw file kind')
     bytes=File.binread(path)
     need(Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(bytes)==r[key+'_sha256'],'raw SHA '+key)
     need(bytes.bytesize==r[key+'_bytes'], 'raw length '+key) unless key=='argv'
     need(JSON.parse(bytes)==r['argv'],'argv contents') if key=='argv'
   end
   need(r['stderr_bytes']==0 && r['binary_sha_before']==r['expected_binary_sha256'] && r['binary_sha_after']==r['expected_binary_sha256'],'empty stderr/stable process binary')
   stdout=File.binread(File.join(root,'invocations',r['stdout_file']))
   if r['process_kind']=='clickhouse-local'
     need(r['expected_binary_sha256']==runtime_sha && r['argv'].include?('--max_threads=1') && r['argv'].include?('--max_memory_usage=536870912'),'native argv guards')
     lines=stdout.lines.map(&:chomp)
     need(lines.select { |l| l.start_with?("__W241_PIN__\t") }==[pin],'raw runtime build/version')
     if %w[native_attach_check_rows native_stock_write_check_rows].include?(r['label'])

       end
       need(nr==expected_native,'raw literal values and all six Dynamic type traces')
     end

     report=JSON.parse(stdout)
     need(report['format']=='dynamic_recursive_handoff_w249_helper_v1' && report['expected_rows']==rows,'helper literal bedrock')
     need(report['keys']==[1,2,3,4,5] && report['mark_row_counts']==[2,2,1] && report['profile']==s['string_profile'],'helper grid/profile')

       need(obs['table_window']==rows.select { |v| [3,4].include?(v['pk']) },'raw selected window')
       need(obs['table_candidate_marks']==rows.select { |v| [1,2,5].include?(v['pk']) },'raw selected granules')
     end
   end

   part=s['parts'][name]
   names=Dir.children(part['path']).sort
   need(names==part['files'].map { |e| e['path'] }.sort,'part complete roster')
   part['files'].each do |e|
     file=File.join(part['path'],e['path'])
     need(File.file?(file) && !File.symlink?(file) && File.size(file)==e['size'] && Digest::SHA256.file(file).hexdigest==e['sha256'],'part file kind/size/SHA')
   end

 generated=s['parts']['library_generated']; attached=s['parts']['native_attached']
 need(attached['files'].reject { |e| e['path']=='invalidated_system_columns.txt' }==generated['files'],'ATTACH preserved every generated file')

 need(offline['part_files']==stock['files'],'offline copy identity inventory')
 copies=Dir.glob(File.join(offline['root'],'store','*','*','all_1_1_0'))

 results << {'root'=>root,'mode'=>s['helper_mode'],'profile'=>s['string_profile'],'native_calls'=>4,'helper_calls'=>2,

end
